name: mic-frequency-response
description: Build a provenance-aware microphone response database from manufacturer numeric values or reproducibly traced official published curves. Ships frequency-response and polar-pattern skills plus a zero-dependency seeded pixel Digitizer. Formal data rejects manual/AI visual point estimates, records per-curve data_origin and digitization_method, and keeps frequency-response CSV points inside the manufacturer-declared range. Original source images are never committed.
